text:
elaine: Heads-up—saw a customer report where the function hook returned a JSON string instead of an object and our validator marked it as a hard reject. Can we quickly align on how to annotate these so the console and alerts are useful?
raj: Ugh. Is this the "returns stringified payload" case again? :grimacing:
noah: yep. Logs show payload:
```
{"tool_response": "{\"result\": \"ok\"}", "hook_id": "search_v1"}
```
and the validator rejects because the response type is string not object.
sanjay: Current pipeline emits a rejection event with code=STRUCT_MISMATCH and minimal context. We don't tag whether it was coercible (we could attempt a parse) or whether it was clearly a tool bug vs model hallucination.
amanda: For console UX I'd like a small set of annotations: error_reason, attempted_coercion, original_raw, redaction_level. We should avoid showing full originals by default (PII risk) but allow expand.
elaine: Agreed. Proposed fields for telemetry/alerts:
- error_reason: STRUCT_MISMATCH | PARSE_ERROR | EXTRA_FIELDS
- attempted_coercion: true|false
- coercion_strategy: parse_json | salvage_with_regex | none
- display_hint: redact | show_preview | show_full
raj: +1. Also we need a dashboard metric: validation_rejects_by_reason with hook_id and sample_rate. That will help prioritize model vs adapter fixes.
noah: Implementation note: don't store original_raw in hot telemetry. Emit a trace_id and short hash for linking to secure artifact store (retention + permissions). Storing raw in main DB is a compliance headache.
sanjay: Ops-bot: do we have an existing secure artifact flow for heavy payloads? ops-bot: Yes — trace artifacts go to s3-retain-encrypted with access via audit-only IAM role. We can attach trace_id to telemetry.
amanda: UX question: how should console surface these rejects? My thought: show a compact summary row with reason + coercion attempt + link to sample (if customer allowed). Provide a toggle for "show raw" with two-step confirm.
elaine: Also need a decision on billing: should requests that ultimately failed validation (and fell back to safe route) be billable? Current billing counts tokens upstream even if tooling failed.
raj: Product edge: customers will argue against being charged for fail-fast rejects. But our infra still processed them. Maybe bill partial (ingress tokens only) and mark final tokens zero when validated reject triggered.
noah: Technically we already surface meter_tag = validation_reject for accounting. We can add a meter_bucket: ingress_only and emit separate cost events. Needs ledger change.
sanjay: Rollout plan: add telemetry fields + console preview behind feature flag. Start with 1% internal canary, then 10% beta customers who opt in to richer debugging.
amanda: For the console, design will show: badge (Reject), reason, coercion icon, "Open sample" (restricted), and a CTA to open a support ticket prefilled with trace_id.
elaine: Quick patch idea: when validator sees a string that parses to the expected object, mark attempted_coercion=true and set coercion_strategy=parse_json, then route to success pipeline but increment coercion_metric. That reduces user-visible rejects while we fix adapters.
raj: I like that as a temporary grace. But we must surface coerced responses clearly so product teams know quality impact.
noah: Logged: add metric coerced_vs_accepted_by_hook and a label coerced=true/false.
sanjay: Also add an alert if validation_rejects_by_hook spikes > 5x baseline in 10m for production customers.
amanda: UX follow-ups: mockups for console rows by EOD? I can do a quick one and post here.
elaine: I'll make a small RFC summarizing fields, storage plan, billing impact, and rollout steps. Tagging @raj @noah for implementation owners. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
raj: On it. I'll draft the validator changes (coercion-first opt-in) and telemetry emitters.
noah: I'll wire up the artifact trace flow and ledger event change PRs.
sanjay: I'll add the alert and sampling toggles to ops playbook.
amanda: Mockup incoming in ~3h.
ops-bot: New action created: #5532101234 — RFC draft + telemetry PRs. Assignees: raj, noah, sanjay; due 2026-03-27.
elaine: Perfect. If anyone sees a customer impacted in the wild, tag this thread and paste trace_id. We'll use it to prioritize.
